item.text:
**Verdict:** 2024 left Turkey’s political freedom and democratic resilience **weaker overall** than Erdoğan inherited it. There were a few narrow resilience signals, mainly opposition wins in local elections and one Constitutional Court pushback, but the year also featured continued media control, online censorship, removal of elected mayors, and renewed term-limit erosion talk.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Turkey’s resurgent opposition thumps Erdogan in pivotal local elections](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-resurgent-opposition-thumps-erdogan-pivotal-local-elections-2024-03-31/) | Reuters | 2024-04-01 | https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-resurgent-opposition-thumps-erdogan-pivotal-local-elections-2024-03-31/ | The opposition won Istanbul, Ankara, and the nationwide popular vote, showing real electoral contestability and some preserved democratic resilience at the municipal level. | 4B.10; 4B.1; 4B.8 |
| Positive | [Turkey’s Erdogan says March election will be his final, state media reports](https://theprint.in/world/turkeys-erdogan-says-march-election-will-be-his-final-state-media-reports/1994063/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-09 | https://theprint.in/world/turkeys-erdogan-says-march-election-will-be-his-final-state-media-reports/1994063/ | Erdoğan publicly described the March local vote as his “final” election, a weak but real acknowledgement of term-limit and succession norms. | 4B.10; 4B.8 |
| Positive | [Press Release concerning the Decision Annulling Certain Provisions Amending the Law on the Regulation of Internet Broadcasts and the Prevention of Offences Committed through Such Broadcasts](https://www.anayasa.gov.tr/en/news/constitutionality-review/press-release-concerning-the-decision-annulling-certain-provisions-amending-the-law-on-the-regulation-of-internet-broadcasts-and-the-prevention-of-offences-committed-through-such-broadcasts/) | Constitutional Court of Türkiye | 2024-01-10 | https://www.anayasa.gov.tr/en/news/constitutionality-review/press-release-concerning-the-decision-annulling-certain-provisions-amending-the-law-on-the-regulation-of-internet-broadcasts-and-the-prevention-of-offences-committed-through-such-broadcasts/ | The court struck down parts of the internet-law framework used for blocking and content removal, showing limited institutional pushback against executive control. | 4B.10; 4B.4; 4B.9 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Government Removes Elected Opposition Mayors](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-07 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | The government removed elected mayors and dissolved councils, replacing them with appointees. That weakens local democratic mandates and shows that opposition victories were not fully respected. | 4B.10; 4B.4; 4B.8; 4B.7 |
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House describes continued authoritarian consolidation, concentration of power, and a tilted political environment, which means the baseline democratic condition at year-end was still poor. | 4B.10; 4B.4; 4B.5; 4B.7; 4B.8 |
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-net/2024 | Despite fewer throttling incidents, the report says the AKP increased censorship and surveillance, criminalized online speech, and kept pressure on platforms and users. This is democratic weakening, not resilience-building. | 4B.10; 4B.6; 4B.9 |
| Negative | [Erdogan ally floats Turkey constitutional amendment to let him extend his tenure](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/erdogan-ally-floats-turkey-constitutional-amendment-to-let-him-extend-his-tenure-3701715) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/erdogan-ally-floats-turkey-constitutional-amendment-to-let-him-extend-his-tenure-3701715 | Erdoğan’s ally publicly floated changing the constitution so he could run again in 2028, which undermines the credibility of term limits and succession rules. | 4B.10; 4B.8 |
| Negative | [Turkey](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey | The report says Erdoğan entered the new term with continued tight media control, and the March 2024 local election was the ruling party’s biggest defeat since 2002. That combination shows resilience in society, but a still-captured information environment. | 4B.10; 4B.5; 4B.6; 4B.9 |

**Search gap:** I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan left Turkey’s democratic resilience broadly stronger than it began. The strongest pro-resilience items were limited to local electoral contestability and a narrow Constitutional Court ruling, while the larger pattern remained coercive and institutionally degrading.
